SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "warehouseTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status = 1) AS "warehouseActive",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_location WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "locationTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_location WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status = 1) AS "locationActive"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM inv_warehouse WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at BETWEEN #{startDate}::TIMESTAMP AND #{endDate}::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY "period" ORDER BY "period"
